entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who senses Amonkhet's pain and deduces Bolas corrupted rather than created the plane.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who accompanies Nissa, bonds over friendship, and wants to learn what Bolas changed.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who enters Oketra's Trials as her champion.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage woken by a mummy bringing breakfast.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer in the neighboring room who denies sending the mummy.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon revered as the God-Pharaoh, believed by Nissa to have corrupted Amonkhet only decades ago.

entities.name: Hapatra
entities.description: A vizier of Rhonas in her mid-thirties with a pet snake who tells Nissa and Chandra about the Trials and the Hours.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: The cat-headed god who forbids the group from approaching the sarcophagi and calls Gideon her Champion.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet whose monument is a cobra's head and who taught Hapatra poison-making.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A god Nissa wishes to question.

entities.name: The soul of Amonkhet
entities.description: The voice of the dying plane that Nissa senses, speaking of its curse and its stolen catacomb dead.

entities.name: Yahenni
entities.description: An aetherborn whose death Nissa recalls.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: A Ravnican Azorius character Nissa compares Hapatra to.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: An old, grieving desert plane whose soul is nearly dead.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: A glistening immaculate city of trainees and mummy laborers.

entities.name: Rhonas's Monument
entities.description: An ancient cobra-headed monument by the river where a sphinx sits atop an obelisk.

entities.name: The Hekma
entities.description: The barrier shielding the city.

entities.name: The sarcophagi
entities.description: Ancient painted coffins in a forbidden alley.

entities.name: The catacombs
entities.description: Underground caverns once meant to safeguard the dead, now empty.

entities.name: The Anointed
entities.description: Enchanted mummies that perform all labor.

entities.name: The Trials
entities.description: Competitions that the youth train for in hopes of a triumphant afterlife.

entities.name: The Hours
entities.description: The period after the God-Pharaoh's return when the sun rests between the horns.

entities.name: The Curse of Wandering
entities.description: A curse making the dead rise unless they decompose, called the plane's gift.

entities.name: Sphinx
entities.description: A sphinx perched on an obelisk that has taken a vow of silence.

entities.name: The Eldrazi
entities.description: Cosmic threat Nissa compares Bolas to.

events.summary: In a vision Nissa hears Amonkhet's soul describe its curse and the catacombs from which Bolas took their dead.
events.quote: I protected the vessels to keep their souls alive and he took. . . them . . .

events.summary: Nissa wakes, finds the plane's soul painful to touch, and asks Chandra to search for the shouting woman.
events.quote: "I'm going to go on a walk to find the woman from yesterday.

events.summary: A mummy bursts in with breakfast, startling the group.
events.quote: a white-bandaged mummy burst through the door carrying a tray of bread and a carafe of what smelled like ale.

events.summary: Nissa and Chandra walk through Naktamun, noting that everyone is a trainee under twenty and mummies do all the labor.
events.quote: The enchanted dead were the ones who did all the work.

events.summary: Nissa, feeling ill, confesses to Chandra that she is learning what friendship means; Chandra says she wants to be a good friend.
Hapatra introduces herself at Rhonas's Monument and explains that preserved bodies are enchanted to serve the living while they train for the Trials.
events.quote: We preserve the bodies left behind, and since training for the Trials is our mortal duty, we enchant the vessels to act in service to humanity.

events.summary: Hapatra reveals the God-Pharaoh's return and the Hours begin when the sun rests between the horns, any day now.
events.quote: "The Hours will begin when the sun rests between the horns. I'd estimate any day now."

events.summary: Nissa and Chandra realize they have two days to find answers and follow Nissa's sense of the woman's energy toward an alley.
events.quote: felt the tug of the woman's energy through what was left of the leylines.

events.summary: In an old alley, Nissa sees carved glyphs showing eight gods and a recently added horns sigil, concluding Bolas corrupted rather than created Amonkhet.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas didn't create this world , she realized, he corrupted it.

events.summary: Oketra appears, forbids approaching the sarcophagi, and Nissa tells her telepathically that her world is dying; Oketra shows fear and has no memory of before.
events.quote: " These sarcophagi are forbidden to approach ," Oketra said out loud.

events.summary: Gideon reveals he is competing in the Trials as Oketra's Champion despite Chandra's objections.
events.quote: "These gods are good at their core. I want to prove myself to them."

events.summary: Nissa tells Chandra that Bolas corrupted Amonkhet only decades ago, and they resolve to learn what he changed and to speak with Kefnet.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas must have come and gone only a few decades ago.

relations.note: Oketra calls Gideon her Champion for the Trials.
relations.quote: "Come, Champion. It is time for your next Trial."

relations.note: A vizier of Rhonas's monument who learned from Rhonas.
relations.quote: "Rhonas taught me I am only as strong as the community I foster.

relations.note: Nissa concludes he corrupted the plane.
relations.quote: he warped it, perverted it, took what he liked and ruined what wasn't his.

relations.note: The monument stands in the city by the river.
relations.quote: The building sat at the edge of the river
